description: The M50 Designer Marketplace booking interface exists with full backend integration, but has no inbound link or active entry point from the canonical branding gateway.
evidence: src/app/dashboard/creator/phase-2/branding/page.tsx only renders 'Open Brand Studio' and 'Skip for now'.
recommendedAction: Either add a secondary CTA on /phase-2/branding ('Or work with an M50 Designer') or deprecate and redirect to the service provider directory.

description: Legacy 30-line standalone page rendering LogoCreationModal in isolation, bypassing the 7-step BrandStudioShell and breaking brand system completeness.
evidence: src/app/dashboard/creator/phase-2/logo-tool/page.tsx renders LogoCreationModal directly and navigates to complete.
recommendedAction: Deprecate the route and redirect all inbound traffic to /dashboard/creator/phase-2/brand-studio.

description: Backend DerivePhase2Step uses legacy step integers (6, 7, 8, 9, 12) from an older 12-step path, which differs from frontend 5-screen step presentation.
recommendedAction: Add clear code documentation explaining the legacy step integer mappings or normalize to 1-5 in a future API revision.

description: Market Study computes a validated TAM in Step 3.1, but Step 3.4 Forecast input defaults to €50,000,000 rather than reading the calculated value.
recommendedAction: Seed inputs.tam in ForecastPage from journey.phase3Data.marketStudySession.output.tamSamSom.tam.amount if present.

description: Business Plan is positioned at Step 3.3 before Forecast (3.4), Compliance (3.5), and Formation (3.6). As a result, Sections 7, 8, and 12 display unhydrated placeholder states on first view.
evidence: BusinessPlanPage.tsx lines 144-153, 158-167, 207-214 show fallback messages when upstream modules are not yet completed.
recommendedAction: Add clear status indicators ('Will sync automatically upon completing Step 3.4/3.5') on unhydrated sections or offer a final review step.

description: Deep links to Step 3.5 without ?ideaId= rely on in-memory or fallback active idea, which can desynchronize if the user switches active ventures in another tab.
evidence: ComplianceWorkspacePage.tsx reads searchParams.get('ideaId'), but breadcrumb/back navigation does not consistently append ?ideaId=.
recommendedAction: Standardize all intra-phase route transitions to append ?ideaId=${activeIdeaId} when an explicit idea is active.

description: On viewport widths < 1024px, the 3-column layout (Navigation, Canvas, AI Guide Rail) stacks vertically, pushing the contextual AI guide rail to the bottom.
recommendedAction: Implement a tabbed view or bottom sheet for the AI Guide Rail on viewports below 1024px.

description: If a user attempts to complete Step 3.7 without an AI forecast or business plan, the backend returns a 422 error which displays a toast, but does not provide a 1-click jump to the missing module.
evidence: CreatorPhase3Controller.cs lines 881-893 return 422 with 'Missing module: financial_forecast' or 'business_plan'.
recommendedAction: Render an interactive missing module remediation card linking directly to the incomplete step if a 422 is returned.
